tagline: Astrana Health, Inc. is a healthcare organization that provides integrated healthcare services and operates risk-bearing care delivery networks.
hero_kpi_rationale: EBITDA of $123.1 million reflects the company's operational ability to generate cash flow, with a slight year-over-year decline of 3.3% despite revenue growth following the acquisition of Prospect.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company's operations, including integrated healthcare activities.
kpis.description: Total revenue represents all income generated from healthcare operations and related activities.
kpis.signal: Significant revenue growth driven by the acquisition of Prospect Medical Holdings.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Measures operational performance before financial expenses, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.
kpis.description: EBITDA is a key indicator of a company's ability to generate cash flow from operations.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in operational profitability despite revenue growth.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: EBITDA adjusted for non-recurring items, stock-based compensation, and other adjustments.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA excludes non-recurring items and stock-based compensation expenses for better operational visibility.
kpis.signal: Growth in adjusted operational profitability reflecting improved performance.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue converted into Adjusted EBITDA, an indicator of operational profitability.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA margin reflects operational efficiency and the ability to convert revenue into operating profits.
kpis.signal: Slight compression in adjusted operating margins.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income represents the company's total profit after deduction of all expenses.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in net income due to higher interest expenses.

kpis.name: Adjusted Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income adjusted for non-recurring items and extraordinary charges.
kpis.description: Adjusted net income excludes non-recurring items for better visibility into underlying profitability.
kpis.signal: Growth in adjusted net income despite operational challenges.

kpis.name: Adjusted EPS - Diluted
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings per share based on diluted shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Diluted adjusted EPS measures the earnings attributable to each common share outstanding.
kpis.signal: Growth in adjusted earnings per share reflecting improved profitability.

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Cost of borrowing funds by the company.
kpis.description: Interest expenses reflect the cost of debt financing for the company.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in interest charges following financing for the refinancing and acquisition of Prospect.

kpis.name: Provision for Income Taxes
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to pay income taxes.
kpis.description: The provision for income taxes represents the estimated taxes the company will have to pay.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in tax expense in line with lower net income.

kpis.name: Depreciation and Amortization
kpis.explanation: Allocation of the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful life.
kpis.description: These charges reflect the loss in value of the company's assets over time and include amortization of intangibles from acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Sharp increase in depreciation and amortization charges due to acquisitions and integrations.

kpis.name: Amortization of Intangibles
kpis.explanation: Amortization of intangible assets acquired in acquisitions.
kpis.description: Amortization of intangibles includes patents, trademarks, customer relationships, and goodwill acquired.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in amortization of intangibles reflecting strategic acquisitions.

kpis.name: Stock-Based Compensation
kpis.explanation: Expenses related to stock options, restricted stock, and other equity-based compensation.
kpis.description: Stock-based compensation represents the opportunity cost to shareholders in terms of equity dilution.

kpis.name: Acquisition of Prospect Medical Holdings
kpis.explanation: Completion of the acquisition of certain operations and assets of Prospect Medical Holdings, Inc.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Prospect Medical Holdings marks a significant step in Astrana's growth and consolidation of its asset and revenue base.
kpis.signal: Major strategic move for expansion and consolidation in integrated healthcare.

kpis.name: Acquisition of Prospect Medical Holdings
kpis.explanation: Completion of the acquisition of certain operations and assets of Prospect Medical Holdings, Inc.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Prospect Medical Holdings marks a significant step in Astrana's growth and consolidation.
kpis.signal: Major strategic move for expansion and consolidation.
